messages:
emma: Hey team — customer BrightLeaf (account BR-5543) flagged that their CSV export for 2026-03-14 shows usage rows attributed to a different org id (org_08bf) which doesn't match the dashboard. Invoice is higher than expected. export S3 path: s3://redwood-exports/2026-03-14/usage-2026-03-14-shard-7.csv

mike: can you paste a couple sample rows? maybe a header mismatch or column shift

emma: pasted sample:
```
org_id,customer_id,tokens,model,timestamp
org_08bf,BRIGHT-ACME,1200,text-davinci-003,2026-03-14T10:04:00Z
org_08bf,BRIGHT-ACME,800,text-davinci-003,2026-03-14T11:01:00Z
```
But the dashboard shows those tokens under org_0a2c (BrightLeaf's canonical org id)

amon: quick hypothesis — we rolled out tenant aliasing last week; export pipeline still joins on legacy org_id field, while the invoice pipeline uses canonical org_id. Might be an alias -> canonical mapping regression

sara: logs from export-worker around 10:00: 
```
warn: alias_lookup failed for alias "BRIGHT-ACME" at exporter/mapper.js:112
```
Also a few SQS trace ids: xyz-123, xyz-124

mike: if alias resolution fails rows might be written with the upstream org_id string. Does the CSV include both alias and canonical anywhere? looks like the org_id column currently contains the alias/old id

emma: confirmed header shows `org_id` but values are old id `org_08bf` — canonical in our DB is `org_0a2c`. Dashboard and invoice disagree because they use canonical mapping

amon: repro query I ran to see spikes:
```
SELECT org_id, count(*) FROM usage_rows WHERE date = '2026-03-14' GROUP BY org_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;
```
shows a large spike on `org_08bf` compared to normal

amon: mitigation plan: run a targeted backfill mapping `org_08bf` -> `org_0a2c` for affected day's batches and re-run aggregation. Need S3 path + shard id and billing pre-approval for invoice adjustment if needed

emma: shard id in filename: usage-2026-03-14-shard-7.csv (that's the affected shard)

nyla: I'll notify BrightLeaf that we're investigating. Do we have ETA for fix and whether invoice will change?

amon: estimate ~2-3 hours to perform the mapping backfill and re-aggregate locally, then 12-24 hours to push through billing UI. If invoice needs manual adjustment we'll coordinate with billing. Estimated delta ~ $900 (preliminary)

mike: tagging billing-bot for acknowledgement and to start invoice reconciliation: @billing-bot please ACK potential invoice delta ~+$900 for BrightLeaf pending repro

billing-bot: received ticket #TKT-9837 — auto-ack. Please attach reconciliation CSV, estimated delta, and root cause notes

support-oncall: adding reproducible runbook for the backfill:
1) copy affected CSV to staging: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-exports/2026-03-14/usage-2026-03-14-shard-7.csv ./staging/`
2) apply alias->canonical mapping script:
```
python tools/fix_org_mapping.py --input staging/usage-2026-03-14-shard-7.csv --map "org_08bf:org_0a2c" --output staging/usage-fixed.csv
```
3) run local aggregator: `./bin/aggregate --input staging/usage-fixed.csv --date 2026-03-14 --out staging/aggregated.csv`
4) validate token totals vs dashboard and attach `staging/aggregated.csv` to the ticket

sara: infra logs show alias_lookup failures only between 09:45-11:15 UTC — that narrows scope. Likely cache eviction + no fallback to canonical lookup in exporter

amon: I'm going to run the manual backfill now and roll a fix that falls back to canonical mapping if alias lookup errors out. I'll open a PR and link it to the incident

emma: I've already informed the customer in ticket BR-5543 and offered a temporary credit if adjustment takes longer than 48 hours :frowny:

nyla: keep me looped — I'll prep the customer comms and escalation notes

mike: follow-ups for postmortem: (1) ensure backfill doesn't create duplicates, (2) exports must be regenerated with canonical ids, (3) incident label for alias-service and add alert on alias_lookup error rate

amon: will attach reconciliation CSV and short runbook to TKT-9837 when done. I'll also include the list of affected shard filenames

emma: thanks all — assigning to amon to drive. I'll update BrightLeaf after the backfill run
